science-v25-explore-lightning: Why does thunder rumble? Lightning is a powerful electrical discharge. It heats the air very quickly, and the expanding air makes a sound wave called thunder. We see the flash before we hear the sound because light travels faster. A little deeper. Lightning can happen inside a cloud, between clouds, or between a cloud and the ground. If you hear thunder, tell a grown-up and go inside a substantial building. Watching from shelter is safer. Something to try. From memory or a picture, draw a storm.
